title: fix(driver-memory)!: retire the legacy default export that CJS require() could not reach
body:
Fixes #26206

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file and no `content/docs/**` page names the retired `default` export or loads the package as a string plugin; the docs teach `InMemoryDriver` by name, which stays

## 维护者速读
- **改了什么**：`@objectstack/driver-memory` 的包入口不再提供 `default` 导出（一个旧式的 `{ id, version, onEnable }` 对象）。`InMemoryDriver` 等所有具名导出不变。这是本卡最后一项，前两项已由 #26321、#26352 落地。
- **为什么改**：这个默认导出不是内核插件（内核约定是 init/start/destroy），而且 CommonJS 用户 `require()` 时拿不到它，类型声明却说有（attw 报 `FalseExportDefault`）。退役后 attw 对该包为 0 问题。
- **风险与回滚**：本仓内默认导入者为 0，示例、脚手架模板、文档、技能里也没有人把它当字符串插件写进 `plugins`。外部若在配置里写了 `plugins: ['@objectstack/driver-memory']`，原来会注册一个内存驱动，现在会静默不注册（changeset 写明改用 `new DriverPlugin(new InMemoryDriver(), 'memory')`）。cloud / hotcrm 未能测到。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts`（删掉的默认导出）；`.changeset/26206-driver-memory-default.md`（BREAKING 说明、ADR-0087 处置与 FROM → TO）；`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/default-export-retired.pin.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`，预期 exit 0 且打印 `verified: @objectstack/driver-memory#default`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄已发布导出面，先过一次契约档复核）。

## What changes

- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts`: the `export default { id, version, onEnable }` object leaves the published entry. Every named export stays. A comment at the old site says why the entry has no default and which named door to use.
- Choice, as the card asks: **drop the default** in favour of the named exports, not "make the CJS default reachable". Reasons:
  1. A reachable CJS default means `require('@objectstack/driver-memory')` itself returns the default object. The entry also has 22 named exports, so that needs an `export =` shape with the named exports merged onto the object. That changes what every CommonJS named import reads today, and it keeps an object that is not a kernel `Plugin`.
  2. Nothing reads it. In this tree: 0 default imports, 0 `require()` calls, 0 `.default` reads after a dynamic import, and 0 string `plugins` entries naming the package (evidence surface below). Control: 14 files (code, docs and skills) import named exports with a static `from`, and 3 code files destructure `InMemoryDriver` from a dynamic `import()`.
- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/README.md`: the `default` row leaves the Key Exports table, and one line says the package has no default export.
- `.changeset/26206-driver-memory-default.md`: `patch` (Metadata-protocol `none`), BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired @objectstack/driver-memory#default)`, and one FROM → TO line. No staged window.
- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/default-export-retired.pin.test.ts` (2 cases): the entry has no `default`, and the named exports stay and `InMemoryDriver` still constructs.

### What changes for a string `plugins` entry (PM assumption 3)

`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:2765` (`mod.default || mod`) loads the project's own config file, not a plugin. The string-plugin door is `materializeStackPlugin` in `packages/core/src/stack-plugins.ts:65`: it loads the module and takes `mod.default || mod`, and an object with no `init` is wrapped in `AppPlugin`, which runs a bundle's `onEnable` with a `drivers.register` that calls `ql.registerDriver`. Measured at that seam (real core `dist`, real driver-memory `dist`, a recording `wrapBundle`):

- before: `wrapBundle` received `id, version, onEnable`, and calling `onEnable` with a driver registry registered `InMemoryDriver(com.objectstack.driver.memory)`.
- after: `wrapBundle` receives the module namespace (`InMemoryDriver`, …, no `id`, no `onEnable`). `AppPlugin` then takes its no-id, no-payload branch (`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`) and becomes an empty no-op plugin, so no driver is registered and nothing says so.

So a config that writes `plugins: ['@objectstack/driver-memory']` changes behaviour. No producer of that spelling was found (search below). The changeset names the replacement for that case.

Restored: blob == HEAD (`a1f49a03fbd9`), `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./index.js`, so it reads `src`, and no build was needed for this leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **Evidence surface for readers of the default** (tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `65b492081`): `git grep` over the whole tree (`examples/**`, `packages/create-objectstack/**` templates, `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, `ui/**`, every package's tests and `scripts/**`) for `import X from` / `import X, { … } from` / `import * as X from` of the package (0), `require('@objectstack/driver-memory')` (0), a dynamic `import()` whose result is read as `.default` or destructured as `default` (0; the 3 code hits all destructure `InMemoryDriver`, the other 2 hits are comments), a `plugins:` line naming the package (0), and the default's id `com.objectstack.driver.memory` (hits are the driver class's own `name`, tests and CLI banner text, none of which reads the default object). `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx` and `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx` teach `InMemoryDriver` by name.
- NOT MEASURED: `objectstack-ai/cloud` and `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` (this session's GitHub reads are bound to this repository; org code search answered 403), and npm dependants.
- The four sibling drivers (`driver-sql`, `driver-mongodb`, `driver-sqlite-wasm`, `driver-turso`) export the same legacy `{ id, version, onEnable }` default. attw 0.18.5 on npm-pack stagings of all four at `161653aed` reports **no problems** (exit 0). So they are not part of this card's acceptance, and this PR does not touch them. Why attw flags driver-memory's build and not theirs (the CJS output has the same shape) was not established.
- The silent no-op above is not specific to this package: a string `plugins` entry naming any module without a default export and without `init` gets the module namespace wrapped into an empty `AppPlugin`. That was read at the seam, not measured through `os serve`, so it is recorded here and not filed.
- ADR-0087 gate (PM assumption 1): `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0, `verified: @objectstack/driver-memory#default (export, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts)`. The blocker fix `cdb949a288` is an ancestor of the base (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0).

They were re-run after `git fetch --depth=1` of the fixture commit and the full packages build, and all 3 exited 0: `112 published require entry point(s) across 69 package(s) load`, `Admitted set held exactly (15 packages)`, `48 cases pass`.
